bandReport.notes: Q54-Q74, 21 questions, seven per page (p09 Q54-60, p10 Q61-66, p11 Q67-74). Seams checked by opening p08 and p12 without transcribing them: p08 ends with Q53 complete (options (a)-(d) all printed) and p12 opens with Q75 complete, so nothing straddles either boundary. NO Directions / 'Consider the following for the next N items' block appears anywhere in p08-p12 — the only 'Consider the following statements :' lines (Q60, Q65, and Q49/Q52 on p08) are self-contained two-statement stems belonging to a single question, not shared stimulus. NO printed diagram on any of p09, p10, p11 — verified at 6-8x on the source PDF for every geometry item, including the ones that sound figure-dependent: Q61 (quadrilateral ABCD), Q63 (cyclic quadrilateral with angle bisectors meeting the circle), Q64 (equilateral triangle trisected side), Q62 (angle bisector) and Q70 (right triangle, circumcircle). All are stated entirely in words, so no hasFigure is set anywhere in this band. The prompt's low-resolution hypotheses about this paper are therefore confirmed for these pages. Booklet is the prep-house retypeset DZOL-T-LKM; page footers read (21-A), (23-A), (25-A). The PDF has NO text layer (0 characters extracted on p09), so everything here is read from the rendered image.

questions.stem: If \(\sin \theta + \cos \theta = \sqrt{2}\), then what is \(\sin^6 \theta + \cos^6 \theta + 6 \sin^2 \theta \cos^2 \theta\) equal to ?
What is the least value of \(9 \sin^2 \theta + 16 \cos^2 \theta\) ?
questions.subtopic: Maximum and Minimum of Trigonometric Expressions

questions.stem: If \(\cos 47^\circ + \sin 47^\circ = k\), then what is the value of \(\cos^2 47^\circ - \sin^2 47^\circ\) ?
If \(\operatorname{cosec} \theta - \sin \theta = p^3\) and \(\sec \theta - \cos \theta = q^3\), then what is the value of \(\tan \theta\) ?
If \(0 \le \alpha, \beta \le 90^\circ\) such that \(\cos (\alpha - \beta) = 1\), then what is \(\sin \alpha - \sin \beta + \cos \alpha - \cos \beta\) equal to ?

Consider the following statements :

1. The value of \(\cos 61^\circ + \sin 29^\circ\) cannot exceed 1.

2. The value of \(\tan 23^\circ - \cot 67^\circ\) is less than 0.

Which of the above statements is/are correct ?
In a quadrilateral ABCD, \(\angle B = 90^\circ\) and \(AB^2 + BC^2 + CD^2 - AD^2 = 0\), then what is \(\angle ACD\) equal to ?
In a \(\triangle ABC\), AC = 12 cm, AB = 16 cm and AD is the bisector of \(\angle A\). If BD = 4 cm, then what is DC equal to ?
ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. The bisectors of the angles A, B, C and D cut the circle at P, Q, R and S respectively. What is \(\angle PQR + \angle RSP\) equal to ?
ABC is an equilateral triangle. The side BC is trisected at D such that BC = 3 BD. What is the ratio of \(AD^2\) to \(AB^2\) ?

Consider the following statements :

1. The diagonals of a trapezium divide each other proportionally.

2. Any line drawn parallel to the parallel sides of a trapezium divides the non-parallel sides proportionally.

Which of the above statements is/are correct ?
If H, C and V are respectively the height, curved surface area and volume of a cone, then what is \(3 \pi V H^3 + 9 V^2\) equal to ?
How many solid lead balls each of diameter 2 mm can be made from a solid lead ball of radius 8 cm ?
The two sides of a triangle are 40 cm and 41 cm. If the perimeter of the triangle is 90 cm, what is its area ?
The diagonals of a rhombus differ by 2 units and its perimeter exceeds the sum of the diagonals by 6 units. What is the area of the rhombus ?
What is the area of a right-angled triangle, if the radius of the circumcircle is 5 cm and altitude drawn to the hypotenuse is 4 cm ?
In a triangle, values of all the angles are integers (in degree measure). Which one of the following cannot be the proportion of their measures ?
